mmaths-2022-tiebreaker-01.prompt: Holden places five paper slips with the numbers $1$ through $5$ written on them into a bag, and draws them out one by one, at random and without replacement. He lets the first slip drawn be $a$, the second be $b$, the third be $c$, the fourth be $d$, and the fifth be $e$. Find the expected value of $10(ab+bc+cd+de+ea)$.

mmaths-2022-tiebreaker-02.prompt: There exist four primes $p,q,r,s$ with $p>q$ and $r>s$ such that $(p+q)(r+s)+(p-q)(r-s)=100$. Find $p+q+r+s$.
